summary: Phase 9 / Tahap B feature B1 Pricing Engine frontend testing completed. All core features working correctly: Settings page 'Aturan Harga (Pricing Engine)' section renders with all vehicle type rates and pricing fields, pre-populated from seeded data. Save and persistence verified. Booking form 'Hitung Otomatis' button successfully auto-calculates price via POST /api/pricing/quote, displays breakdown panel with line items. Public calculator works via Pricing Engine. All regression tests passed.
